decisions.reason: The articulated dumper builds on core competence and visible engineering investment, and two years is still too short to judge, so management keeps it despite no reported results.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line is the largest visible commitment and central to the lifting core, so it is kept.
The material lift line shows strong rental demand and a large order, fits the established offer closely and has just launched, so it is kept.
The underground mining loader has a dedicated page and a publicized operating success, which confirms the firm's investment and public commitment to underground equipment, so it is kept.
